stories.title: These robots can figure out how to do a task after watching humans do it
stories.summary: Swiss scientists have published research showing AI-informed robots can learn how to self correct and teach other robots how to behave. It raises questions of consciousness in artificial intelligence.

stories.title: A 15-year-old shoplifter changed his course when another teen whispered a message
stories.summary: As a teenager, Everett Miller went through a rough time and started shoplifting. He recalls how a girl's whispered message kept him from making a terrible mistake.

stories.title: Millions of immigrants are stuck in the immigration line
stories.summary: The line to get permission to legally work and live in the U.S. is getting longer, frustrating immigrants and putting them at greater risk of deportation.

stories.title: In the American Heartland, farmers are literally betting the farm to stay in business
stories.summary: American farmers hope the Iran ceasefire holds and fertilizer and diesel start moving through the Strait of Hormuz soon, as row crop farmers go into their fourth straight planting season in the red.

stories.title: Vaccine for expectant mothers means fewer RSV hospitalizations for babies, study show
stories.summary: RSV is the most common reason why babies end up in the hospital in their first year. A new study finds a vaccine for expectant mothers is more effective at protecting babies than previously shown.

stories.title: Don Schlitz, Grammy Award-winning writer of 'The Gambler,' remembered
stories.summary: Grammy-winning country songwriter Don Schlitz passed away this month at 73. He was the writer behind songs such as Kenny Rogers' "The Gambler" and Randy Travis' "Forever and Ever, Amen".
